body:
hatch() crashes with `ValueError: duckling count must be non-negative` whenever the brood count is negative.

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "ducklings.py", line 18, in hatch
    return brood(-1)
  File "ducklings.py", line 9, in brood
    raise ValueError("duckling count must be non-negative")
ValueError: duckling count must be non-negative

Expected: an empty flock or a clear caller-facing error, not a raw crash out of hatch().
Environment: ducklings 0.1.0, stock python3, no dependencies.
comments: Repro: install ducklings==0.1.0 and call hatch() with no arguments — crashes every time.
Same here. brood(-1) is the trigger; non-negative counts work fine.
title: ValueError when hatching a negative brood
